summary: Write the chain at g as a sum of terms of gauge ≤ ∏ p^{r_j} (`exists_chain_eq_sum` with gauges as sizes) and use that the coefficients Ψ(x) are p-adically integral.

steps.claim: `exists_chain_eq_sum` with N_j(g, v) = gauge of v at g·d_j (weight (κ, e_j)), r_j = p^{r_j} and B = 1 (joint invariance transported through t, which commutes with the levels).
steps.lean:
r j) (chainComb ϑ Ψ (fun x j ↦ t j (translateDatum x j)) D.m φ) := (exists_chain_eq_sum
  (by simpa +contextual [*] using H.joint_invariant · · <| · ∘ₗ TensorChain.map ..)
  (fun j g ↦ weylGauge _ (D.lastEntry j) (g * d j)) (by simp) h hφ · |>.rec fun _ b ↦ b.2 ▸ by

steps.claim: The gauge of a sum is ≤ the maximum of the gauges (twice).
Each term: gauge(Ψ(x)·β) = |ιₚΨ(x)|·gauge(β) ≤ 1·∏_{j<m} p^{r_j} = p^{∑ r_j} (Ψ(x) integral away from levelNorm(ϑ), p prime to it).
steps.lean:
grw [weylGauge_smul, b.1, ← one_nsmul (Ψ _), nsmul_eq_mul, H.integral _ _ hQ] <;>
      simp [Real.rpow_nonneg, Real.rpow_sum_of_pos, NeZero.pos, *])
